description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Fort Myers, Cape Coral & Sanibel, Florida market through PTF-FORT-MYERS-FL-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-002. Every number is derived from THIS market's committed authority by release_contracts.derive_authority; none is typed and none is inherited from or comparable to another market's contract.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and asserts nothing about the market being complete -- 51 of this market's 142 registered identities are still unresolved, and no founder deployment decision exists for Fort Myers at 57 published profiles.

identity_census.note: 142 registered identities, built from zero by PTF-FORT-MYERS-FL-HARDENED-SOURCE-READY-001 on the Salt Lake City-live hardened lineage and registered by PTF-FORT-MYERS-FL-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-002. Membership is this market's own corridor postal partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY): 14 corridors over admitted Lee County postal codes -- Downtown Fort Myers and the River District, Colonial Boulevard and Cleveland Avenue (US-41), Daniels Parkway and Six Mile Cypress, RSW airport / Gateway / Treeline and East Fort Myers along I-75 at the core; Cape Coral, Fort Myers Beach, South Fort Myers / Iona and the Sanibel causeway, Sanibel and Captiva islands around them; Estero / Coconut Point, Bonita Springs, North Fort Myers and Lehigh Acres / Alva at the fringe. CAPE CORAL, FORT MYERS BEACH, SANIBEL, CAPTIVA, ESTERO, BONITA SPRINGS, NORTH FORT MYERS AND LEHIGH ACRES KEEP THEIR OWN MUNICIPALITY: a row publishes the municipality its own postal code and its own page carry and is never flattened into Fort Myers. A name never places a property: 'Fort Myers', 'RSW', 'Sanibel' or 'Naples' in a hotel's name decides nothing, its own postal code does; shared codes are covered whole, and a Collier-licensed premises in 34134 is refused. Naples, Marco Island, Everglades City, Punta Gorda, Port Charlotte, Englewood / Boca Grande, Sarasota, Bradenton and Venice are named, refused and preserved as future standalone markets: 0 rows are admitted from a refused postal code. Timeshare and vacation ownership, condominium units and resort residences, beach houses and canal homes, nightly-rental condos and property managers, serviced and corporate apartments, member-only clubs and on-base lodging are never admitted or cited; a residence or timeshare never enters because it shares a resort campus, and a beach or island property publishes only on current first-party proof of operation. Rows the identity graph did not admit are recorded, not dropped: 69 IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 105 NAME_ONLY_UNRESOLVED; 143 NON_LODGING; 196 OUTSIDE_MARKET; 2 SAME_CAMPUS_DISTINCT_ENTITY; 1 SAME_IDENTITY_REBRAND_SUCCESSOR.

reconciliation.note: 57 clean pet-friendly and 34 clean verified-no-pets over a 142-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, read by the repaired shared reader (an FAQ question is never an acceptance, and an explicit refusal always wins), bound to its census identity by the property code or the full street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing, one page that binds two census rows publishes for neither, and an identity the census cannot address never publishes. 51 identities did not publish (8 EVIDENCE_HOLD; 2 IDENTITY_MISMATCH_HOLD; 25 ROUTING_HOLD; 16 SOURCE_SILENT); every one is named in fort_myers_fl_clean_authority_001.json with its class. No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record carries the exact operator quote for each published fact, the capture lane, and the sha256 of the document it was read from.

final_partition.note: The partition of record for this market, referenced by path and content digest so the whole-site assembler resolves it from THIS contract rather than from a table in its own source. Written from the committed file by release_contracts.final_partition_block; verified by market_partition_resolution: the file must exist, declare this market_id, hash to expected_sha256 and carry expected_count identities. Regenerating the partition means reissuing this block.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/fort-myers-fl/. 4 of 14 corridors reach their own publication minimum; the rest are suppressed, which is a threshold and not a gap. The market and its corridors are hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false) until a launch order says otherwise.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
